    pay.rewind ();
    super.setPayload (pay);
}

private void reset (){ 
    int count = 0;
    for (int i = 0;i < table.length;i ++){
        count += Long.bitCount (table [ i ] & ONE_MASK);

4173	analysisWe need to produce a one-line summary describing the method's core actions or behavior. The method is static int clamp(int value, int upperLimit). It clamps a value to a range? Let's analyze code:

```
static int clamp (int value,int upperLimit){ 
    if (value < 0){ 
        return value + (- 1 * (int)Math.floor (value / (float)upperLimit))* upperLimit;
    } else { 
        return value % upperLimit;
    } 
}
```

If value < 0: compute value + (-1 * floor(value / (float)upperLimit)) * upperLimit. Let's simplify: floor(value / upperLimit) for negative value gives negative integer less than or equal to value/upperLimit. Multiply by -1 gives positive integer. 7393	analysisWe need to produce a one-line summary of the method's core actions. The method is shutdown().

Let's analyze code:

public void shutdown (){ 
  try { 
    locksExecutor.shutdown ();
    locksExecutor.awaitTermination (5,TimeUnit.SECONDS);
    CountDownLatch latch = new CountDownLatch (1);
    activeLocksLock.writeLock ().lock ();
    Observable.from (activeLocks.entrySet ())
      .map (Map.Entry :: getValue)
      .flatMap (lock -> releaseLock (lock.getName (),lock.getValue ()).map (released -> new Lock (lock.getName (),lock.getValue (),lock.getExpiration (),lock.getRenewalRate (),!released)))
      .subscribe (lock -> { 
          if (lock.isLocked ()){ logger.infof ("Failed to release lock %s",lock.getName ());} 
        }, 
        t -> { logger.info ("There was an error while releasing locks",t);latch.countDown ();}, 
        latch :: countDown);
    latch.await ();
    logger.info ("Shutdown complete");
  } catch (InterruptedException e){ 
    logger.debug ("Shutdown was interrupted. Some locks may not have been released but they will still expire.");
  }
